data.name: NoConnectionConfiguration
data.value: Azure Table Storage connection must be configured. Provide either a connection string, account name and key, or service URI with SAS token.

data.name: RelationshipsNotSupported
data.value: Azure Table Storage does not support relationships between entities. Navigation properties must be ignored or handled client-side.

data.name: ComplexTypesNotSupported
data.value: Complex types are not directly supported by Azure Table Storage. Consider serializing to JSON or using primitive properties.

data.name: CollectionsNotSupported
data.value: Collection properties are not supported by Azure Table Storage. Consider storing as serialized JSON or using separate entities.

data.name: PartitionKeyRequired
data.value: Azure Table entities require a PartitionKey property. Configure using HasPartitionKey() or use the [PartitionKey] attribute.

data.name: RowKeyRequired
data.value: Azure Table entities require a RowKey property. Configure using HasRowKey() or use the [RowKey] attribute.

data.name: CrossPartitionQueriesWarning
data.value: Cross-partition queries may have poor performance. Consider filtering by PartitionKey when possible.

data.name: UnsupportedLinqOperator
data.value: LINQ operator '{operator}' is not supported by Azure Table Storage. Only basic filtering, ordering, and projection are supported.

data.name: MissingPartitionKey
data.value: Entity type '{entityType}' is missing a partition key. All Azure Table entities must have a partition key configured using HasPartitionKey() or the [PartitionKey] attribute.

data.name: MissingRowKey
data.value: Entity type '{entityType}' is missing a row key. All Azure Table entities must have a row key configured using HasRowKey() or the [RowKey] attribute.

data.name: InvalidPartitionKeyType
data.value: The partition key property '{propertyName}' on entity type '{entityType}' must be of type string, but was '{typeName}'.

data.name: InvalidRowKeyType
data.value: The row key property '{propertyName}' on entity type '{entityType}' must be of type string, but was '{typeName}'.

data.name: SamePropertyPartitionAndRowKey
data.value: The same property '{propertyName}' on entity type '{entityType}' cannot be used as both partition key and row key.

data.name: UnsupportedPropertyType
data.value: Property '{propertyName}' on entity type '{entityType}' has type '{typeName}' which is not supported by Azure Table Storage.

data.name: ComplexTypeWillBeJsonSerialized
data.value: Property '{propertyName}' on entity type '{entityType}' has complex type '{typeName}' which will be JSON serialized. This may impact query performance and functionality.
